standard_benchmark.ni_environment: unset in both; native benchmark clears NI_* from server
standard_benchmark.scope: Qwen3.5 4B Q4/group64 + pinned six-layer DFlash v1
standard_benchmark.quality: require nonempty 512-token writing responses and inspect all contention, thermal and paging flags

fixed_prompt_diagnostic.metric: existing bench/harness/bench.py decode_rates middle window and (completion_tokens-1)/(last_content_time-first_content_time)
fixed_prompt_diagnostic.cold_prompts: fresh private server per arm; distinct warm-up inputs; disk cache disabled; check cached tokens
fixed_prompt_diagnostic.purpose: same inputs and text, including decode over a 4K prompt

decision: Expand default only with output gates passed and a repeatable positive inference result larger than within-build variation, with no material regression in the other measured phases. Keep all attempts; a flagged series cannot support a win and any environmental repair/rerun must be declared.
